issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to mark the end of the main loop with the label `loop_end` (problem_statement.md lines 21-22). The solution implementation uses a different label name `end_loop:` (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm line 17) and the template does not provide a `loop_end` label placeholder. This name mismatch between the spec and the solution can confuse students (and any automatic checks) about the required label name and where to place it.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the label name consistent. Preferred fix: rename the solution label `end_loop:` to `loop_end:` (update solution_repository/helloWorld.asm line 17). Optionally, add a commented placeholder label `loop_end:` in the template so students see where to put it, or update the problem statement to accept `end_loop` if that name was intended.

issues.description: The problem statement requires students to mark the end of the main loop with the label `loop_end` but the solution repository uses the label `end_loop`. The template does not include the required `loop_end` label either. This naming mismatch (loop_end vs end_loop) refers to the same conceptual entity (the end-of-loop label) and may confuse students comparing their work to the reference solution or when checking for the required label name.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename the label in the solution from `end_loop` to `loop_end` (or vice versa update the problem statement to require `end_loop`/`end_loop` consistently). Also, ensure the template includes the `loop_end` label at the intended location so students see the expected identifier in starter code.
